ns2:course.label: General Field Research Seminar
ns2:course.description: This course will guide doctoral students as they develop a broad and critical understanding of their general field of doctoral study. Students will conduct a synthesized and critical review of the general field literature, which will become part of their dissertation. This course may meet the doctoral requirement of the General Field Qualifying Examination. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms for up to 8 hours. Prerequisite: To be taken by EPOL doctoral students upon completion of graduate course work. See advisor for guidance.
